name: Taiwan Taxi Co.,Ltd.
summary: Taiwan Taxi Co.,Ltd. serves as a prominent provider of diverse transportation solutions throughout Taiwan. The company's primary offering includes convenient, on-demand taxi services. Beyond standard cab rides, its extensive service portfolio encompasses specialized options such as residential relocation assistance, expedited item delivery and retrieval, professional designated drivers, seamless airport transfers, dedicated transport for special education students, and even unique pet pick-up services. Additionally, their operations extend to managing taxi dispatch, providing rapid courier services, and engaging in advertising. With a substantial fleet comprising approximately 10,000 vehicles, the company caters to an expansive customer base of about 350,000 individuals. Founded in 2005, the firm is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
